title: The Group's website chapter and calendar controls filter real events

source.ref: Frequency Control owner request for The Group suite cohesion and simultaneous local builds, 2026-10-15

detail: NetworkEvents previously painted chapter pills and month cells as inert list/span markup. The event cards stay server-rendered from the same visibility-filtered metadata and retain their canonical event hrefs. A small NetworkEventsExplorer client island filters those rows by chapter/date, updates the next-event CTA and countdown, exposes an honest matching count and empty state, supports month navigation/date reset, and retains the existing theme classes/tokens. Native buttons expose pressed/focus/disabled states. Stored wall-clock date semantics and the existing today-based upcoming policy remain unchanged. Chapter resolution prefers an explicit configured hosting Space ID when event metadata supplies it; legacy title/place matches must be unique rather than choosing the first ambiguous chapter. Tests exercise actual mounted chapter/date controls, next-event links, counts/empty/more/reset/month navigation and calendar boundary math. The actual seeded Group homepage and every other page render through the real Network CSS as a visual fixture under work/group-followup-preview (not a production publication). Read-only identity evidence: Group Space db42cbea-3229-9813-e691-cb0e05272808 is slug the-group, active Collective, published Network website, domain thegrouplocal.com; no thegroupsd record exists. All five chapters and the listed circle records exist. All 147 public/published Group events have public creation scope and zero circle placements, and all twelve stored home circle cards lack circleSlug: real circle calendar association and saved card publication remain data prerequisites, never invented by this local UI change. Desired thegroupsd.frequencylocal.com is not an existing alias under the canonical slug-subdomain resolver; current local proxy previews the actual bound Group domain without a production DNS/DB mutation. Follow-up carries the already-selected host_space_id through SpaceEventItem.hostingSpaceId without a new database query, and the authored Group chapter filters carry the same deterministic Space IDs as their seeded chapter records. A real public content projection test plus actual NetworkEvents render test proves a misleading title cannot override the declared hosting Space. Existing published chapter tags still require saving/publishing the new IDs; no seed transaction is applied by this change. Parent visual review reproduced an ended 9 AM event still advertised as Up next at 2 PM. Calendar cards intentionally remain available all day under the canonical upcoming policy, but the next-event panel now uses timezone-correct start/end instants to skip ended/invalid events, preserve valid ongoing windows as Happening now without a zero countdown, and advance its selection after mount/every 30 seconds. A mounted clock-advance regression and real NetworkEvents wall-clock rendering test cover that consequence. Start a circle in authored seed docs now opens the canonical Frequency sign-in return path to /circles/new (already-signed-in viewers are forwarded by SignInPage); the separate Submit an event external submission route remains unchanged. Network link mapping recognizes canonical app circle/event/sign-in paths and sends them to the provided Frequency origin. These authored CTA updates, like slug/ID fields, still need a reviewed content publication; no production mutation occurs. Final bounded commerce connection: each authored merch card opens its verified canonical /market/<product-id> public detail, with View product instead of falsely implying an Add to cart action; Shop all remains the Space shop overview. Read-only live verification confirms all four seeded records are active, their prices match the authored cards, and Group storefront.published is true (market_published is false, so native product visibility relies on the intentionally published storefront gate). All three membership tier prices also match today; no sale, payout readiness or future price synchronization is claimed. Zero accepted/pending Group Collective cross-listing rows were found: chapter circles cannot be silently aggregated past that explicit-consent seam. Remaining circle event placement and authored content changes are local review manifests only, not applied to the shared production database.
